text: Purchases of property and equipment are investing outflows. Sales proceeds and incentives are separate inflows. Principal finance-lease and financing-obligation repayments are financing outflows. Operating-lease assets acquired, property acquired under finance leases and changes in property acquired but unpaid are supplemental observations, not additional current cash payments.

text: Issuer free cash flow is operating cash flow less property/equipment purchases net of sales proceeds and incentives. Its definition does not subtract finance-lease principal or financing-obligation principal. An analyst may show those further cash-payment deductions separately, without calling them the issuer measure. The narrative attributes increased property purchases primarily to investment in artificial intelligence, without identifying a precise amount in the supplied cash-flow statement.
